Fidelity includes factual content, action scope, independent content, chronology, tense/modality, uncertainty, attribution, cancellation/correction meaning, deliberate repetition, naturalness and absence of invented facts/actions. Exact quoted payloads were personally checked; loader validation is separate supporting evidence.
evidence_limitation: This is assistant review of synthetic training examples, not fresh accuracy evidence, human validation or a population accuracy claim. No blind-round2 content or author/status files accessed. Initial schema inspection displayed the first row inline notes; the remaining review read only id/input/target.
